name: tern-todo
summary: Publish an interactive Glitch plan identity for the native Tern TODO view, without prompting or changing an agent's input.
way_in: When /glitch-plan (Codex: $glitch-plan) creates or deliberately resumes/revises a canonical plan, read this companion's README.md and publish its existing checkpoint identity. Identify the actual durable agent pid; clear on fresh startup and before conversation reset/end or leaving the plan. No managed skill or hook is overridden.
